question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?
rendered:
The nucleation overpotential for bare Al was 19 mV and for carbon/Al was 12 mV. To find the percentage reduction, we use the formula: 

((19 - 12) / 19) * 100 
= (7 / 19) * 100 
= 36.84%

So, the carbon layer reduced the sodium nucleation overpotential by approximately 36.84% of the bare-Al value.
